verdict.rationale: The IPO's gov.uk guidance is written for non-lawyers. The trade mark page explains in plain terms why to register (protect your brand, use ®, take legal action, sell or license). It then walks through the task: check for existing marks, apply online or by post, view a timeline, with the £205 fee and 10-year renewal stated on the page. The patent page likewise explains in plain language how to file, the One Login requirement, the paper fallback, and when you can get faster processing. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on confirmation that founders find it easy to follow, the full step sequence is only implied by the excerpts rather than shown as a numbered walkthrough, and the patent guidance excerpts are thinner than the trade mark ones.
